boundedDecisions: New activity_read_store module uses the existing configured repository connection and one owner-correlated SELECT. Highest session id determines token and sanitized status from the same row.
Known lifecycle enum only; absent/unknown state remains unknown and has no token. Failed/expired latest session has no token and cannot revive older active session.
Pending closed session shows safe closure/support advice; sent receipt keeps review label, stored receipt shows received-file label; paid/sent/terminal order status takes precedence.
Preserve deployed shared order_read_store.py byte-exact: checkout has unrelated undeployed changes. Compatibility rehearsal executes new module with retained live dependency.
Deployment adds module then replaces main/HTML and restarts only Relay; exact preimages and journal prohibit blind deployment/restart replay.
custodySecretsMoneyWriters: No new writer, authority, credentials or signatures; tests/rehearsals use synthetic data and no customer rows. Production probes are public unauthenticated reads. Routine Relay restart resumes its already-enabled payment/notification background workers; no claim that existing background effects are disabled or zero.
limitations: Real Telegram/iOS/WebKit, screen-reader behavior and human comprehension remain unverified.
Synthetic failures do not establish actual customer incidence or imply failed funds/order/refund.
Unknown session metadata is not proof of closure; known nonclosed lifecycle state is not a payment or network confirmation.
Pre-existing live shared-repository drift remains explicitly preserved, not silently rolled out.
E4 and earlier gates remain open.
validationEnvironment: LUMI venv supplies pytest; existing Relay venv supplies psycopg3.3.4 for disposable PostgreSQL. Initial PostgreSQL rehearsal interpreter lacked psycopg before any container creation; rerun used existing interpreter, no dependencies installed.
